reviews.name: Thandi M.
reviews.text: They found a leak under the floor in under an hour and quoted the price before touching anything. No surprises on the invoice.

reviews.name: Greg P.
reviews.text: Our geyser died on a Sunday night. A technician was at the door in under an hour and we had hot water again by the next morning.

reviews.name: Lerato N.
reviews.text: Camera inspection showed exactly where the blockage was. The crew cleaned up properly and even swept the floor.

reviews.name: Johan v. R.
reviews.text: Reliable, on schedule and the compliance report was ready the same day. Our restaurant inspection went smoothly.

reviews.name: Aisha K.
reviews.text: Three fixtures fitted in one visit. Friendly, tidy and exactly the price they had quoted.

reviews.name: Daniel S.
reviews.text: Priority scheduling across our rental units has cut our tenant complaints noticeably. One number to call, every time.
